newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo to present debt deal to state lawmakers.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo to present debt deal to state lawmakers.

text.p: Sao Paulo Finance Secretary Yoshiaki Nakano will present this afternoon the terms of a rescheduling deal for Sao Paulo's debt to state lawmakers, said a spokesman for Sao Paulo Legislative Assembly.

Under the deal, which refinances a major part of Sao Paulo's massive debt, the state will sell a 51 percent stake in its bank Banespa to the federal government for a price to be determined after one year.
Banespa will be run by a private manager for one year who will be selected in a bidding process.
The deal, announced on Wednesday by Sao Paulo state governor Mario Covas and federal officials, needs to be approved by state and federal lawmakers.
The spokesman could not say when the Legislative Assembly will vote on the deal.
